newsitem.title: UK: Azlan shares suspended due accounting issues.
newsitem.headline: Azlan shares suspended due accounting issues.

text.p: British computing products and services distributor Azlan Group Plc said on Friday it had requested its shares on the London stock market be suspended "in the light of certain unresolved accounting issues".
Its share price ended 30 pence lower at 555 pence a share.
The company said in a statement that the accounting issues will have a "material effect" on its results for the year to April 5.
The matter is being investigated by the company and its auditors, and as a consequence publication of the annual results, originally scheduled for June 26, will be delayed.
Azlan said it would make a further announcement as soon as possible.
In April the company had said pretax profits in 1996/97 were expected to be in line with expectations at around 14.8 million stg, up from 10.5 million a year earlier.
